body.p: , after , , , . src/xslt_accumulator.c with src/xslt_accumulator_internal.h, five internal rows in src/function_library_xslt.c, tests/xslt_accumulator_test.c; hooks in src/xslt_lower.c (declare, lower, scope of the main function, release, the rule view; field accumulators of sxml_xslt_lowering), src/xslt_lower_construct.c (xsl:copy-of) and src/xslt_key.c (fn:copy-of, fn:snapshot). No IR kind, no evaluator change, no public header.

item.p: Lowering (as templates, ): each xsl:accumulator-rule is a match function (its pattern, , in a TRY_CATCH making every error false, 6.5) and a rule function of ($node, $value) with the node as fixed focus and $value (no namespace) bound, its select or sequence constructor coerced to as (XPTY0004); initial-value the same over the root. One declaration per name, the highest import precedence (XTSE3350 at a tie); XTSE3355, XTSE3185, XTSE3300 (use-accumulators of xsl:mode and xsl:source-document: names of accumulators, none twice, #all alone). streamable is read and ignored.

Traversal (19.4, no recursion, ): per accumulator an IR function lowered from an XPath text (as src/xslt_key.c's, ): a fold-left over $root/descendant-or-self::node() (attributes and namespaces are not visited) whose state map holds the value, an explicit stack of nodes whose end event is pending, and two maps from generate-id to the pre- and post-descent values; each node first closes the stack entries that are not its ancestors (end events, innermost first), then has its start event; the last rule in document order of the phase whose pattern matches gives the value. Depth is found in one step for a first child or a sibling, else by the ancestor axis.

Values (19.3, lazily per tree): fn:accumulator-before/-after are IR functions of a function table put in front of every static context (after the XSLT function table, before 4.12's). Row accumulator-values builds once per evaluation, accumulator and root, through the evaluation memo (, reused: no new store); while building, the entry is the empty sequence, so a rule asking for its own accumulator raises XTDE3400; a failed build leaves a retry mark, so every later call raises the error again (19.5). XTDE3340 (accumulator-name: an xs:QName, or an EQName resolved as fn:key's names), XTTE3360.

Applicability (19.2): row accumulator-scope records the applicable accumulators of a tree in the memo: the main function for the initial match selection (use-accumulators of the initial mode's xsl:mode; none without one), xsl:source-document for its document (with streamable="yes" only accumulators declared streamable); every other tree has all of them; accumulator-values raises XTDE3362 for one left out.

Copies (19.10): fn:copy-of, fn:snapshot and xsl:copy-of with copy-accumulators="yes" link each copy to its original in the memo (row accumulator-link, only when the stylesheet declares an accumulator); the accumulator functions map a node under a linked copy to the node at its place in the original and read that tree's values.
xsl:source-document (18.1, no streaming): fn:doc of href, the scope, the content with the document node as singleton focus (no packet owned it).

Not done: streaming; XTDE3350 (an absent focus raises XPDY0002); xsl:merge-source use-accumulators (4.9's xsl:merge); a copy of a copy; 19.5's functional dependency (one failing rule fails every call on that tree). Costs: a node deeper than a first child or a sibling pays its depth; a call on a linked copy pays the copy's size; memo entries are a list (many linked copies make lookups linear).
